# transform

Graph transformation step registry wrappers. Wraps base step classes from Steps.js with dynamic registration, JSON serialization, and AST conversion hooks for query execution pipeline.

## Contents

- [BindPathStep.ts](./BindPathStep.ts) — Wraps BaseBindPathStep. Static stepName="BindPath". fromJSON validates `["BindPath", { pathVariable: string }]`.
- [CallStep.ts](./CallStep.ts) — Wraps BaseCallStep. Static stepName="Call". fromJSON validates `procedureName` string, `arguments` array, optional `yieldItems`.
- [ExpressionReturnStep.ts](./ExpressionReturnStep.ts) — Wraps BaseExpressionReturnStep. Static stepName="ExpressionReturn". fromJSON validates `items` array with expression references.
- [LabelsStep.ts](./LabelsStep.ts) — Wraps BaseLabelsStep. Static stepName="Labels". fromJSON validates optional `returnAsString` boolean.
- [MapElementsStep.ts](./MapElementsStep.ts) — Wraps BaseMapElementsStep. Static stepName="MapElements". toJSON throws, fromJSON returns null (function mapper prevents serialization).
- [PropertyValuesStep.ts](./PropertyValuesStep.ts) — Wraps BasePropertyValuesStep. Static stepName="PropertyValues". fromJSON validates `items` array.
- [SelectStep.ts](./SelectStep.ts) — Wraps BaseSelectStep. Static stepName="Select". fromJSON validates `pathLabels` string array.
- [UnfoldStep.ts](./UnfoldStep.ts) — Wraps BaseUnfoldStep. Static stepName="Unfold". Transforms arrays into elements.
- [ValuesStep.ts](./ValuesStep.ts) — Wraps BaseValuesStep. Static stepName="Values". Flattens TraversalPath values recursively.
- [index.ts](./index.ts) — Barrel re-exports all nine step classes and config types.
